title: French Pumpkin Gratin
description: A rich and creamy French-inspired pumpkin gratin, perfect for a cozy dinner. This comforting dish is made with tender pumpkin, velvety sauce, and crispy breadcrumbs.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced pumpkin and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Stir in the velvety sauce and nutmeg.
Transfer the pumpkin mixture to a baking dish.
Top with grated breadcrumbs and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly.
